speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Selma, you haven't touched your food.

text:

I've swallowed it.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Now it's up to my enzymes.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
That's the judge's tray.
He's on the phone.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Got another lead on those tickets.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I must say, I've never seen anybody
so whipped up about a concert.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Well, you know how he is
about Mel Torme.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Personally, I don't see the big
attraction about Mel Torme.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I like singers that stick to the tune.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...that bird on Sesame Street's not bad either.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
The concert's been sold out
for two weeks...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I don't believe it. I am two days
away from getting shut out.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: No, Liz. Woodstock was only a concert.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I make money the old-fashioned way.
I print it.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Dan, you're a very funny guy.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You'll scream. You'll faint.
You'll see skyrockets going off.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Is it me, or has Dan
been different lately?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: You think there's been a little...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Just because people work together
and have coffee breaks together...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Don't look now.
He's kissing her hand.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Listen, you lured me in here
with the promise of a cup of coffee.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

and stick to your lips.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Dan, I think the others
want us to join them.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I think you might be right.
It looks like our Dan is in love.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Has anyone ever told you what
a cute vaccination scar you have?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Well, if it isn't two of
the loveliest ladies...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Liz, that may be the smartest

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...and you have worn
some smart outfits.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Don't you dare change that hair.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Remember that movie about the pods
in the basement?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
A poem I wrote on the subway
this morning.

text:
Must be hard to find something
to rhyme with "jurisprudence."

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Looks like love is in
full bloom over there.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
The massive amounts of fertilizer
have helped, I think.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Don't be so hard on him.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Haven't you ever been
madly in love with someone?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
What I mean is, I don't think
that it's appropriate...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...for people who work together
to have...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Have you ever been
madly in love with someone?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I doubt it. She was
a cute dark-haired girl...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...who sat next to me
in second grade.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - I forget her name, but she was wild.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: You see, in our version of hide-and-seek...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: The People v. Leo Bell, Your Honor.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Mr. Bell was arrested near
Madison Square Garden...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

about this whole thing, judge.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: See, I made my little niece a promise:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
The next time the ice show comes to town,
her Uncle Leo would take her.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
But then two weeks ago,
something else took her.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...and I got stuck
with the ticket, right.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: You thought you might sell the ticket?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
So someone else's niece
could enjoy the show.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Well, that seat was right behind

text:

text: I couldn't have said it better myself.

text: Well, how do you explain this, Mr. Bell?

text: You must have 200 or 300 tickets here.

text:

text:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

text:

text:

text: There must be 30 Mel Torme tickets here.

text:

text:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Your thinking was clear,
your logic, precise.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

text:

to the city property clerk.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I'm sorry, but I couldn't
help overhearing, and...

text:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
At least one of them.
See, I'm a big fan too.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - I wondered if you might wanna...

text: Oh, no, no. I mean, he's a very nice guy.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

why don't we go get pizza. My treat.

text: I'd love to, but I can't.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I'm already doing something this evening.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

something this evening.

text: What exactly will we be doing this evening?

text: Sorry, Dan. I have a date.

text:

text: Deadly. Who are you going out with?

text:

text:

text:

text: - I can't believe he said that.

text: I told him he could call me "Harry."

text: I have never known Dan to be late before.

text:

text: - The part that stayed down? Fine.

text:

text: Dan, it is just a dinner date.

text:

text: I'm sure he presumed way too much...

text:

kicked in the teeth.

text: - I'm sure that to feel that a friend...

text: That we were getting so backed up!

text:
...the amount of money

text:

text:

once you've spent it?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Look at it from my point of view.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I was nuts about her. No.
Scratch that. Insane about her.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I gave her all of my love, all of my

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...for Bobbo the Human Redwood

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...but we have to put
personal problems...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - I am going to soil your bench.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Dan, we've all been through rejection.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Hasn't anything like this
ever happened to you before?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Harry, I was just jilted in favor of a man

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Now, be fair.
Bull has his share of talents.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Dan, Suzanne appears to be
a wonderful woman.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You know, I really, really thought
that we were simpatico, Harry.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: She appeals to a lot of people.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: We shared so many of the same interests.

text: I imagine a lot of people appeal to her.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: She likes Torme. I like Torme.

text: Her nose wrinkles when she laughs at them.

text: Come on in. Come on in.

text:
I think we have something

text:
The year in combs.

text: Okay, that is enough of that.

text:

text:

text:

text: - Perhaps you'd like to step outside.

text:

text:

text:

text:

text: All right, now the two of you link up.

text:
Okay, guys.

text: His bond is breaking my knuckles.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

text:
Dan, there is no reason

text:

Date within your species.

text: I have no idea what she sees in him.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
We were just trying

text: Did you want to see me?

text:

text:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Dan enjoys oompah bands. So do I.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You and I love Mel Torme,
so we're going to the concert...

text: - Lana, you wanna hear a funny story?

text: Your Honor, you better hurry. It's bad.

text: - Bull and Dan in the cafeteria...

text:
I passed by. Bull was throwing

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: He was lucky there was a doctor here.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Couple of cracked ribs, that's all.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You big, overgrown oaf!

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...to death on an olive

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Bull, I am so sorry
for what I thought and what I said.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Any bandages or tape around here?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - In the guard's lounge. Follow me.

text: Bull, I said some pretty nasty things.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - You didn't say anything that nasty.

text:

text:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...l'm not a plaything

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:

text:

text:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...that's why I wanted to be with you?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
She just happened to have
an extra seat to the...

text:
Is that something?

text:

text:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Listen, I'm going.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - No, no. You own that ticket now.

text:

text:

speaker: UNKNOWN

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I guess it got a little crazy around here.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Well, gentlemen, I appreciate

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Harry, I think Mel put it best

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: We're all going to Emilio's for a beer.

text: - It's been a crazy couple of days.

text:

text:
